name: Makeet
subtitle: Habits, at your pace
promotionalText: Choose your days, see progress in your calendar and make room for the weeks ahead. Every small step counts.
description:
Choose your days, count every small step and make room in your calendar. Habits that matter, at the pace of your life.

More than a checkmark
Count glasses, pages, minutes or repetitions, several times a day and beyond your goal. Minus on the left, plus on the right: adjust a quantity and keep going.

A week of your own
Monday, Tuesday and Thursday? Pick days for each habit, along with a goal, increment, icon or emoji. Rest days do not break your streak.

A history you can correct
Edit past-day quantities from the calendar, review and save. You can also change a habit, archive it, restore it or permanently delete it and its progress after confirmation.

A plan that looks ahead
Plan today, 7, 14 or 28 days. Makeet suggests slots using your chosen days, preferred times, progress and commitments. Review and confirm before future events are created.

Calendars, with your permission
Choose which device calendars to read and where to add Makeet blocks. Google Calendar works when configured on your device; events sync according to the calendar provider’s settings.

See what works for you
Explore quantities, consistency, streaks and logging times. The monthly view gives you the full picture; statistics help you notice your patterns.

FREE LOCAL USE
Create unlimited habits, log quantities, explore statistics and plan in your calendar without an account. Guided onboarding helps you choose between keeping progress on your device and signing in with Apple or Google.

MAKEET PLUS
Private archive sync across your devices is available with a monthly or annual subscription. Prices and terms appear in the app before purchase. Manage your subscription in your Apple account settings.

Available in Italian, English, French, German and Spanish. Your own habit names and units stay as you enter them.

reviewNotes:
Makeet is a quantitative habit tracker. Core local use does not require an account.

1. In onboarding, choose the local/device option and finish the guide.
2. Tap + to create a habit. Choose an icon or emoji, weekdays, target and logging increment.
3. Use minus/plus to adjust progress. Calendar shows the combined monthly heatmap and permits explicit past-day corrections. Habit detail supports editing, archive/restore and confirmed permanent deletion.
4. In Planner, grant calendar permission only if you want to test calendar integration. Configure a readable source and writable destination. Review and confirm before Makeet creates any future blocks. Existing device calendar accounts, including Google configured in iOS, use EventKit. Signing in with Google does not grant calendar access.
5. Account access is optional through native Sign in with Apple or Google. Use your own review identity; no developer credentials are required. An explicit import choice is required for an existing local archive.
6. Makeet Plus offers account sync across devices by monthly or yearly subscription. Planning, calendar integration and all local tracking remain free without a subscription. Purchase and Restore use StoreKit. Account deletion and JSON export remain accessible without an active subscription.

No advertising or tracking SDK is included. Calendar event contents stay on the device. Support: https://makeet.app/en/support
